description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Starkey is hiring a software engineer to develop and maintain hearing-aid fitting software focused on acoustics and signal processing. The role collaborates with R&D, clinical, and customer-facing teams to bring new hearing-aid features to market, investigate field issues, and analyze data.
Acoustics software engineer modeling hearing-aid performance and debugging fitting issues for clinicians

Responsibilities:
• Working in a modern C#/.NET codebase that is leveraged by all of Starkey’s customer-facing and internal software applications to program hearing aids
• Working with R&D cross-functional teams to build and maintain the subsystem of our fitting software that is focused on modelling the acoustics of our hearing aids as well as the impact of new signal processing algorithms on acoustic performance
• Collaborating with clinical and customer-facing teams to debug and root cause issues that audiologists face in the field
• Learning to balance tradeoffs and technical constraints that impact acoustic performance, usability, and maintainability for patients and clinicians
• Analyzing and presenting data to decision-making stakeholders
• Receiving mentorship from seasoned software engineers and engineers in other disciplines as you learn the hearing aid domain from every angle

Requirements:
• Experience and interest in both software development and acoustics with a bachelor's degree in at least one of these areas: computer science, electrical engineering, hearing science, audiology (or adjacent domain)
• Understanding of object-oriented software design
• A learner's mindset with a willingness to ask questions and soak up knowledge
• Ability to thrive in a team environment
• Passion for science, data-driven decision making, and experimentation
